## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem, what changes and the result for users. Link a public issue if relevant.

## Evidence and validation

List the checks actually run, the affected version/skill/tool, public source references and any skipped checks or remaining limitations. Distinguish structural tests from a native assistant task result.

## Contribution checks

- [ ] Inputs and examples are independently invented or verified public material with recorded rights; no company data, private links, real-work derivatives or credentials are included.
- [ ] Authoritative sources were edited and applicable generated files rebuilt; checksums and version records agree.
- [ ] The change follows CONTRIBUTING.md and preserves published releases unless an explicitly reviewed privacy-removal exception applies.
- [ ] New claims have concrete evidence. No unavailable tool, host installation, source coverage or model improvement is implied.
